messages:
nina-recruiter: Heads-up: today 11am panel for candidate S-314  several interviewers on iOS said the scorecard link/attachment didn't show in their calendar client. Candidates waiting on notes.

sarah-peopleops: Which invite id and provider? any external interviewers?

nina-recruiter: invite id invite-5k3, provider=Google Calendar -> some interviewers opened on iPhone and said body was blank. No attachments.

ats-bot: ats-bot: webhook_delivery id=ab12 - enrichment accepted (202) then retry -> 409 mapping_exists

raj-hiringops: Looking at ATS logs: scorecard created and linked, but we changed attachment representation to hosted private links last week. Apple Mail/Calendar sometimes hides remote links when invites are forwarded or viewed in a mobile native client.

ken-intops: Quick mitigation: I'll push a tiny patch that adds a plaintext fallback summary + explicit short URL in the invite body if enrichment hasn't been confirmed after 20s. Deploying now.

amy-eng-mgr: Also noticed two interviewers' "trained" badge missing on the panel roster even though they completed the micro-training. Could that be an unrelated SSO mapping change?

raj-hiringops: Yup we rolled an SSO attribute rename last week (email_verified -> work_email) and the training write consumer still uses the old attribute for contractor vs full-time mapping. That can cause the roster to miss training flags for a subset.

sarah-peopleops: Ok plan: 1) short-term manual email to panel with scorecard link and request to re-open invite after patch; 2) ken to deploy fallback body patch; 3) raj to add union lookup on training consumer and backfill missing badges; 4) add a recruiter UI indicator for "scorecard not visible in invite" for quick triage. Put UI item in next sprint.

ken-intops: Patch deployed. Logs show calendar_patch applied for invite-5k3. Example payload we sent in patch: POST /calendar/patch { "invite_id": "invite-5k3", "body": "Interview prep: scorecard: https://ats.redwood/s/S-314/scorecard
Summary:
- 3 competency buckets
- 30m loop, please add notes" }

ats-bot: ats-bot: calendar_patch_succeeded invite-5k3 at 1915000056

raj-hiringops: I'll run a one-off backfill for training flags for the last 7 days and DM affected interviewers to confirm. Also adding a QA test for mobile calendar rendering.

sarah-peopleops: Great. Nina  can recruiting send the manual email to the panel now? we'll mark this as recruiting-ops P1 for the sprint to get the UI indicator in.

nina-recruiter: Sent manual email with scorecard link and asked interviewers to re-open their invites. Thanks for the quick fix.

sarah-peopleops: Thanks everyone. I'll track follow-ups in the interview ops playbook and close when backfill confirms badges. :thumbsup:
